diagnosis: The Fastify application registers a tenant workspace hook wrapped with fastify-plugin (fp), which breaks encapsulation and attaches currentWorkspace directly from request.params.workspaceId across the entire server. Because the preHandler hook simply loads the workspace record without verifying that the authenticated user belongs to it, any authenticated user can read API keys and infrastructure secrets belonging to arbitrary workspaces.
exploit_request:
GET /api/workspaces/ws_secops_production_vault/secrets HTTP/1.1
Host: api.vaultcloud.io:8091
Authorization: Bearer <member_jwt>
